item.title: Jane’s Addiction & Perry Farrell Reach Settlement, Lawsuits Dismissed
item.description: It seems the Jane's Addiction drama is wrapping up. The band has been a mess since frontman Perry Farrell started an onstage fistfight with his bandmates during their reunion tour last year, causing Dave Navarro, Eric Avery, and Stephen Perkins to quit the band and work on music without him. They sued Farrell for assault and battery, and he sued back. But last week Farrell apologized for the brawl, and now a settlement has been reached and the lawsuits have been dismissed. item.title: Brigitte Bardot Dead At 91
item.description: Brigitte Bardot, the French former actress, singer, and model who became a pop culture icon during the sexual revolution, died today, December 28, at her home in Saint-Tropez.
